battle.name: 第三次印巴戰爭
battle.brief: 第三次印巴戰爭於一九七一年在印巴邊境爆發，東巴基斯坦戰區迅速出現軍事對抗，西線亦隨之升溫。惠氏步槍（Winchester Model 1873）於一八七三年開始服役，曾是美軍制式地面步槍，採用連發槍機，屬遠距程輕武器。

kit.name: 惠氏步槍
kit.history: 惠氏步槍是美軍早期制式地面步槍，配備連發槍機，主要用於中遠距程射擊，作為步兵與支援部隊的個人直射武器，而非車載或航空裝備。

countries: 1971年第三次印巴戰爭是印度共和國與巴基斯坦聯邦之間的戰爭，交戰主體為印度與巴基斯坦；東巴基斯坦當時仍是巴基斯坦的自治省，並非獨立國家。西部戰線沿克什米爾、印度河上游、印度旁遮普與拉賈斯坦展開，北端包括Nathu La、Cho La等山區哨所；東部戰線則由錫里古里、特里普拉、阿薩姆與梅加拉亞一帶的印度邊境伸入東巴基斯坦，跨越賈穆納河、帕德瑪河等水道，經邁門辛、道甘地、庫米拉、達卡與吉大港推進。孟加拉灣的海上戰線以吉大港、PNS Hangor巡邏區及印度護衛艦隊的活動為核心。戰爭始於東巴基斯坦的軍政危機；巴基斯坦於12月3日進攻印度西部後，成為明確的兩國全面戰爭，印度與Mukti Bahini在東部共同作戰，巴基斯坦則同時應付東西兩翼。
countriesEn: The Third Indo-Pakistani War of 1971 was fought between the Republic of India and the Federation of Pakistan; the belligerents were India and Pakistan, while East Pakistan remained an autonomous province of Pakistan rather than an independent state. The western front ran through Kashmir, the upper Indus, Indian Punjab, and Rajasthan, with outposts in areas such as Nathu La and Cho La at its northern end. In the east, the front extended from the Indian borders around Siliguri, Tripura, Assam, and Meghalaya into East Pakistan, crossing the Jamuna and Padma rivers and advancing through Mymensingh, Daudkandi, Comilla, Dacca, and Chittagong. The maritime front in the Bay of Bengal centered on Chittagong harbor, the patrol area of PNS Hangor, and the operations of the Indian escort force. The war began as a military-political crisis in East Pakistan. After Pakistan attacked western India on 3 December, it became a conventional interstate war: India and the Mukti Bahini fought together in the east, while Pakistan had to conduct operations on both fronts.
people: 巴基斯坦方面，Yahya Khan以總統兼陸軍參謀長掌握最高軍權；陸軍中將A. A. K. Niazi自三月起擔任東巴基斯坦全軍最高指揮官，少將M. A. G. Osmani指揮當地部隊與防務，空軍中將Asghar Khan掌管的巴基斯坦空軍負責兩翼制空、偵察與攻擊任務。Comilla的第3東孟加拉團守軍由A. M. Ahmed中校指揮。印度方面，Sam Manekshaw中將在戰役關鍵階段主持第十一軍，Sagat Singh中將指揮第三軍，J. F. R. Jacob中將指揮第四軍，Gurbux Singh中將率領第22步兵師，K. K. Ahluwalia少將指揮第1裝甲師；P. N. Rawal掌Eastern Air Command。西部由D. S. Sodhi中將的第四軍、K. K. Narang中將的第十軍及G. S. Sandhu中將的第三十三軍接戰。Mukti Bahini主要由起義或脫離巴基斯坦軍序列的孟加拉軍人組成，分區行動，並與印度指揮官協調道路、渡點、火力及情報。
peopleEn: On the Pakistani side, Yahya Khan held supreme military authority as both president and chief of the army staff. Lieutenant General A. A. K. Niazi became the overall commander of all Pakistani forces in East Pakistan from March, while Major General M. A. G. Osmani directed the local troops and their defensive deployment. Air Marshal Asghar Khan commanded the Pakistan Air Force in interception, reconnaissance, and strike operations across both fronts. Lieutenant Colonel A. M. Ahmed commanded the 3rd East Bengal Regiment garrison at Comilla. On the Indian side, Lieutenant General Sam Manekshaw directed XI Corps during the decisive phase, Lieutenant General Sagat Singh commanded III Corps, and Lieutenant General J. F. R. Jacob commanded IV Corps. Lieutenant General Gurbux Singh led the 22nd Infantry Division, Major General K. K. Ahluwalia commanded the 1st Armoured Division, and P. N. Rawal headed the Eastern Air Command. In the west, the Indian forces came under the corps commanded by Lieutenant Generals D. S. Sodhi, K. K. Narang, and G. S. Sandhu. The Mukti Bahini consisted principally of Bengali soldiers who mutinied or left the Pakistani armed forces. It operated in sectors and coordinated roads, river crossings, fire support, and intelligence with Indian commanders.
kits: 1971年雙方使用的裝備均為此前已列裝的型號。印度步兵主要配Sterling 9毫米衝鋒槍、7.62毫米GPMG（DP）與30口徑Browning Automatic Rifle；巴基斯坦步兵同樣使用Sterling，並配7.62毫米FN MAG。印度陸軍有T-54主力坦克、PT-76輕型坦克及M47、M48中型坦克，巴基斯坦則有Type 59、Chieftain與M47、M48。火炮包括105公厘M2A1野戰砲、25磅砲、印度155公厘自走砲及巴基斯坦105、130公厘榴彈砲。印度空軍使用MiG-21、Su-7、MiG-17、Hunter、Canberra、HS 748與Il-76，另有Mi-4及UH-1D直升機；巴基斯坦空軍裝備Mirage III、F-6、F-86F、MiG-19與Alouette III。印度海軍以Type 14護衛艦INS Khukri、Kuthir、Veer、Vikram及飛彈艇INS Nipat、Betwa、Brahmaputra執行作戰；巴基斯坦則使用Type 093潛艦PNS Hangor及近岸巡邏艇。地面後勤依靠卡車、鐵路、公路與空運，補給品包括9毫米、7.62毫米子彈以及105、130、155公厘砲彈。
kitsEn: All equipment used in 1971 had entered service earlier. Indian infantry were armed chiefly with the Sterling 9 mm submachine gun, the 7.62 mm GPMG (DP), and the .30-caliber Browning Automatic Rifle. Pakistani infantry also used the Sterling and the 7.62 mm FN MAG. The Indian Army fielded T-54 main battle tanks, PT-76 light tanks, and M47 and M48 medium tanks; Pakistan fielded the Type 59, Chieftain, and M47 and M48 tanks. Artillery included the 105 mm M2A1 field gun, 25-pounder, Indian 155 mm self-propelled gun, and Pakistani 105 and 130 mm howitzers. The Indian Air Force operated MiG-21, Su-7, MiG-17, Hunter, Canberra, and HS 748 aircraft, together with Mi-4 and UH-1D helicopters. The Pakistan Air Force had Mirage III, F-6, F-86F, and MiG-19 fighters and Alouette III helicopters. The Indian naval force included the Type 14 frigates INS Khukri, Kuthir, Veer, and Vikram and the missile boats INS Nipat, Betwa, and Brahmaputra, while Pakistan employed the Type 093 submarine PNS Hangor and coastal patrol craft. Ground logistics depended on trucks, railways, roads, and air supply. The principal ammunition included 9 mm and 7.62 mm rounds and 105, 130, and 155 mm shells.
tactics: 印度最初採取限制進攻、逐步集兵的作法。Operation Jackpot以小股突進、偽裝滲透和邊境部隊攻擊，奪取交通點並破壞巴基斯坦的指揮連線；至十一月，印度完成兵員、砲兵、空軍與後勤集結，才轉為軍級攻勢。東部作戰中，第四軍由錫里古里方向進入，第三軍由特里普拉及梅加拉亞方向展開，第十一軍與第22、第27步兵師掩護側翼；第2、第3、第6步兵師沿主要公路向道甘地與達卡推進，第8、第17及第54步兵師控制北翼、渡點與達卡外圍。工兵架橋、砲兵射擊、空中近距支援及坦克步兵協同依序投入，Mukti Bahini則破壞道路、襲擊孤立哨所和引導游擊隊進入。巴基斯坦在東部依靠據點防守與局部反擊，因孟加拉籍部隊倒戈而難以形成一致的軍級反攻。西部則以裝甲部隊突進邊境哨所，再向Fazilka、Hussainiwala及查谿方向擴張；印度利用地雷、反戰車壕、步兵防線與集中裝甲反擊阻止其突破。空戰由雙方戰鬥機攔截、對地攻擊及運輸機支援構成；海戰則包括印度飛彈艇攻擊吉大港，以及PNS Hangor發射反艦飛彈打擊印度護衛艦。
tacticsEn: India initially limited the scale of operations, built up its forces, and then shifted to a corps-level offensive. Operation Jackpot used small attacks, infiltration, deception, and border troops to seize communication points and disrupt Pakistani command links. By November, India had assembled infantry, artillery, air units, and logistics for larger operations. In the east, IV Corps entered from the Siliguri direction, III Corps advanced through Tripura and Meghalaya, and XI Corps with the 22nd and 27th Infantry Divisions protected the flanks. The 2nd, 3rd, and 6th Infantry Divisions advanced along the main roads toward Daudkandi and Dacca, while the 8th, 17th, and 54th Infantry Divisions secured the northern flank, river crossings, and approaches to Dacca. Engineer bridging, artillery fire, close air support, and combined tank-infantry operations were brought in successively. The Mukti Bahini disrupted roads, raided isolated posts, and guided guerrilla forces inland. Pakistani operations in the east relied on fortified points and local counterattacks, but Bengali mutinies made a coherent corps-scale counteroffensive difficult. In the west, Pakistan used armour to penetrate the border posts and expand toward Fazilka, Hussainiwala, and Chhamb. Indian mines, anti-tank ditches, infantry positions, and concentrated armoured counterattacks prevented a breakthrough. Air operations consisted of fighter interception, ground attack, and transport support. At sea, Indian missile boats attacked Chittagong, while PNS Hangor launched anti-ship missiles against an Indian frigate.
data: 戰役時序由3月25日開始。Yahya Khan在東巴基斯坦發動Operation Searchlight，多支孟加拉籍部隊隨即起義或脫離原建制；印度則加強邊境部署。4月3日夜至4日，Operation Jackpot展開，印軍越過邊界控制若干道路與通信點；4月9日，Comilla的第3東孟加拉團在A. M. Ahmed中校率領下放下武器。十一月，Mukti Bahini加強對東巴基斯坦內部的破壞與聯絡，印度完成三軍與空軍集結；同期西部的Longewala戰役於11月13日至16日進行，查谿方向的戰鬥則發生於11月20日至22日。12月3日0800，巴基斯坦在西部動員步兵、裝甲與炮兵，全面攻擊印度邊境哨所；Fazilka、Hussainiwala、查谿及Jammu—Tawi一線相繼交戰。12月4日至5日，印度在受攻各段加固陣地並集中裝甲部隊。12月6日夜至7日晨，印度海軍飛彈艇與護衛艦攻擊吉大港港區。12月7日至8日，印度部隊由多條邊界進入東巴基斯坦，主攻於8日展開；12月10日，第3步兵師與Mukti Bahini奪取道甘地，切斷吉大港至達卡的鐵路與公路連絡；同夜至11日凌晨，PNS Hangor以反艦飛彈擊沉INS Khukri。12月中旬，印度的空中與海上攻擊持續破壞吉大港設施，Fazilka於13日由印度部隊奪回，PNS Hangor亦在後續空海交戰中沉沒。12月16日1200，Niazi與Osmani在達卡向印度第三軍簽署投降書；12月17日全面停火。西部零星據點至12月下旬陸續停火，印度部隊於22日進入吉大港市區，其餘孤立守軍則在月底前解除抵抗。
dataEn: The chronology began on 25 March 1971, when Yahya Khan launched Operation Searchlight in East Pakistan. Several Bengali units mutinied or left their formations, while India reinforced the border. During the night of 3 and 4 April, Operation Jackpot began, and Indian troops crossed the frontier to seize roads and communication points. On 9 April, the 3rd East Bengal Regiment at Comilla laid down its weapons under Lieutenant Colonel A. M. Ahmed. In November, the Mukti Bahini intensified disruption and liaison inside East Pakistan as India completed the concentration of its three corps and air units. On the western front, the Battle of Longewala ran from 13 to 16 November, and fighting around Chhamb followed from 20 to 22 November. At 0800 on 3 December, Pakistan mobilized infantry, armour, and artillery for a general attack against Indian border posts. Fighting developed at Fazilka, Hussainiwala, Chhamb, and along the Jammu–Tawi axis. On 4 and 5 December, India consolidated its positions and concentrated armour on the threatened sectors. During the night of 6 and the early hours of 7 December, Indian missile boats and frigates attacked Chittagong harbor. On 7 and 8 December, Indian troops entered East Pakistan across several borders, with the principal effort beginning on 8 December. On 10 December, the 3rd Infantry Division and the Mukti Bahini captured Daudkandi, cutting the road and rail connection between Chittagong and Dacca. That night and early on 11 December, PNS Hangor sank INS Khukri with anti-ship missiles. Indian air and naval attacks continued to damage Chittagong facilities in mid-December; Indian troops retook Fazilka on the 13th, and PNS Hangor was sunk during subsequent air-sea operations. At 1200 on 16 December, Niazi and Osmani signed the surrender document in Dacca before Indian III Corps. A general ceasefire followed on 17 December. Isolated western positions ceased fighting gradually during the latter half of December; Indian troops entered Chittagong city on the 22nd, and the remaining isolated garrisons surrendered before the month ended.
cause: 戰爭的根源是東巴基斯坦的憲政衝突、軍隊政治化及巴基斯坦對印度介入的估計。1970年大選之後，執政的Ayub Khan把軍政權移交Yahya Khan，議會運作與Six-Point Movement所提出的自治要求始終未獲解決。Yahya Khan在3月25日以Operation Searchlight壓制軍政反對力量，造成孟加拉籍營、團陸續倒戈，使巴基斯坦在東翼的指揮、徵召與後續補充迅速惡化。印度利用邊境兵力和Operation Jackpot削弱巴基斯坦邊防，並公開支援Mukti Bahini，使巴基斯坦相信印度正準備利用東巴基斯坦的局勢發動進攻。1971年8月的印巴友好條約及印度在北部與東北部增加軍力，又加深了巴基斯坦的安全疑慮。巴基斯坦無法同時固守漫長邊境與擁有裝甲部隊的西部，因而選擇在冬季主動進攻：若能迅速越過印度邊界、奪取據點並消耗印度裝甲兵力的話，巴基斯坦便可重新建立東西兩翼之間的兵力平衡。印度則因巴基斯坦已跨越邊界而被迫應戰，並計畫先在西部阻斷裝甲攻勢，再集中第三、第四、第十一軍完成東翼攻勢。地形也影響雙方決策：北部山區低溫、濃霧與道路狹窄，孟加拉境內河流、稻田、縱深交通與燃料儲備則使快速進攻及補給比帳面距離更困難。
causeEn: The war arose from the constitutional crisis in East Pakistan, the political role of the armed forces, and Pakistan's estimate of Indian intervention. After the 1970 election, President Ayub Khan transferred political and military power to Yahya Khan, while parliamentary procedures and the Six-Point Movement's demand for autonomy remained unresolved. Yahya Khan launched Operation Searchlight in East Pakistan on 25 March against the military-political opposition. Bengali battalions and regiments then mutinied or left their formations, rapidly weakening Pakistani command, recruitment, and reinforcement on the eastern front. India used troops on the frontier and Operation Jackpot to disrupt Pakistan's border system and openly supported the Mukti Bahini. Pakistan consequently believed that India was preparing to exploit the conditions in East Pakistan. The 1971 Indo-Pakistani Treaty of Friendship and the Indian buildup in the north and northeast further deepened Pakistan's security concerns. Unable to defend a long frontier and retain its western armour simultaneously, Pakistan chose to attack before winter. It hoped to cross the Indian border rapidly, seize positions, and wear down Indian armoured strength before India could concentrate against it. India, after the frontier was crossed, was compelled to respond and adopted a plan to contain the western attack while committing III, IV, and XI Corps in the east. Terrain and logistics also shaped the operation: low temperatures, fog, and narrow roads restricted movement in the northern mountains, while rivers, flooded fields, poor communications, and limited fuel reserves complicated rapid advance and resupply inside East Pakistan.
impact: 最直接的軍事影響，是巴基斯坦在東翼的指揮體系、兵源補充與戰區補給鏈在十二月中旬解體。達卡、錫里古里前沿、邁門辛、Comilla、庫米拉、錫里古里以北地區及吉大港先後由印度與Mukti Bahini控制；吉大港港區受損後仍提供後續船運與空運所需的碼頭設施。巴基斯坦投降時留下大量槍砲、彈藥、車輛、通訊器材與其他軍用裝備，部分成為新國家軍隊裝備的來源，許多被俘官兵則依停火安排陸續遣返。西部戰線的結果不同：巴基斯坦未能形成可持續的突破，第1及第6裝甲師等部的推進被印度以防禦和反擊阻止，但部分邊境據點及山區陣地仍由巴基斯坦控制。印度在西部大致恢復開戰前的控制線，卻沒有取得足以改變西部邊界的廣大土地。東巴基斯坦解體後宣布成立Bangladesh，並於1972年獲國際承認，使印度取得東側的長期戰略位置，卻也承擔在新國家建立軍政秩序、維持邊境與部署軍力的成本。海空戰的實際交鋒顯示潛艦反艦飛彈、飛彈艇沿岸攻擊、MiG-21與F-6等戰鬥機作戰，以及武裝直升機支援地面部隊的新階段；這些經驗後來直接影響印度與巴基斯坦的海空軍建設、兵種部署和後續邊界備戰。
impactEn: The most direct military effect was the breakdown of Pakistan's eastern command structure, manpower replacement system, and theater supply chain in the second half of December. Dacca, the approaches from Siliguri, Mymensingh, Comilla, the Chittagong area, and the northern routes were taken by Indian and Mukti Bahini forces. Although damaged, Chittagong harbor still supplied the wharves required for later maritime and air logistics. At the surrender, Pakistan left behind large quantities of weapons, ammunition, vehicles, communications equipment, and other military stores. Some of this material formed part of the new state's armed forces, while numerous prisoners were repatriated under the ceasefire arrangements. The western front produced a different outcome. Pakistan could not turn its advance into a sustained breakthrough; the movement of formations including the 1st and 6th Armoured Divisions was checked by Indian defensive concentrations and counterattacks, although Pakistan retained a number of border positions and Himalayan strongpoints. India recovered approximately its prewar control line in the west but did not acquire enough territory to alter the western frontier. The collapse of East Pakistan was followed by the declaration of Bangladesh and international recognition in 1972. India gained a long-term strategic position on its eastern side but also inherited responsibility for establishing military and administrative order, maintaining the frontier, and stationing troops in the new state. Actual air and naval engagements demonstrated the submarine-launched anti-ship missile, missile-boat attacks on coastal ports, combat between aircraft such as the MiG-21 and F-6, and armed helicopter support of ground forces. These operational experiences directly affected the subsequent development of Indian and Pakistani naval aviation, force organization, and frontier preparedness.
result: 12月16日1200，Niazi與Osmani在達卡簽署投降文件，同意其指揮下東巴基斯坦全部武裝部隊停止有組織抵抗；印度第三軍接收達卡及周邊防務，第54步兵師等單位隨後放下武器。12月17日停火生效後，東戰區主要作戰停止，印度與Mukti Bahini控制達卡、錫里古里以北地區、Comilla、庫米拉、邁門辛、道甘地與吉大港，沿海及鐵路補給線因港口和車站被接管而改由印度掌握。吉大港市區於12月22日由印度部隊進入，月底前其他孤立據點也陸續解除抵抗。西部沒有出現全面崩潰：巴基斯坦在Fazilka與Hussainiwala方向的攻勢受挫，但經由查谿取得的部分陣地及若干高山前哨未被印度奪回，停火線因此不同於開戰前的界線。海上 exchange 同樣留下雙方損失，PNS Hangor擊沉INS Khukri後自身也沉沒，多艘巴基斯坦近岸艇在吉大港攻擊中受損或被擊毀，而印度飛彈艇未遭同等損失。戰後，東巴基斯坦原有巴基斯坦指揮機構解散，投降與被俘部隊依停火條款處置，戰俘分批遣返；Bangladesh建立獨立軍隊並接管北部疆土。整體結果是印度在東部取得全部主要會戰與戰略目標，巴基斯坦在西部保住大部分陣地及部分邊境前哨，但未能收回東翼，也沒有突破印度的西部防線。
resultEn: At 1200 on 16 December, Niazi and Osmani signed the surrender document in Dacca, agreeing that all armed forces under their command in East Pakistan would cease organized resistance. Indian III Corps assumed responsibility for Dacca and its surrounding defenses, and formations including the 54th Infantry Division subsequently laid down their weapons. After the ceasefire took effect on 17 December, major operations in the east ended. Indian and Mukti Bahini forces controlled Dacca, the northern approaches from Siliguri, Comilla, Cumilla, Mymensingh, Daudkandi, and Chittagong; control of the harbor and railway stations placed the coastal and rail supply routes under Indian management. Indian troops entered Chittagong city on 22 December, and other isolated positions disarmed before the end of the month. There was no general collapse in the west. Pakistan's advances toward Fazilka and Hussainiwala were checked, but positions taken around Chhamb and several Himalayan outposts were not recaptured by India, leaving the ceasefire line different from the prewar frontier. The maritime exchange also produced losses on both sides. PNS Hangor sank INS Khukri before being sunk itself, several Pakistani coastal craft were damaged or destroyed in the attack on Chittagong, and the Indian missile-boat force did not suffer a comparable loss. After the war, the former Pakistani command structure in East Pakistan was dissolved, the surrendered formations and prisoners were handled under the ceasefire terms, and prisoners were repatriated in stages. Bangladesh established an independent military and took control of the northern territories. The overall result was that India secured every principal engagement and strategic objective in the east. Pakistan retained most of its positions and several forward outposts in the west, but recovered neither East Pakistan nor a breakthrough through India's western defenses.
